title: Fix tool list inconsistency and test gap in verify-ci-runner
description: Three findings from code patrol scan: (1) scripts/verify-ci-runner line 17 is missing 'bash' from its tool verification loop compared to scripts/verify-nix-base line 57 and the flake.nix runtime_tools metadata. (2) tests/test_flake_contract.py line 60 asserts the wrong tool list (missing bash), so the test passes even though the script is incomplete — the test validates the buggy value instead of the correct one. (3) .github/workflows/auto-merge.yml line 39 references CODEOWNERS in a protected-paths grep but no CODEOWNERS file exists in the repo — dead code that misleads contributors. (4) .github/workflows/publish-ci-runner.yml line 40 and verify-ci-runner.yml lines 36,72 use actions/checkout@v7.0.1 which is non-standard (other workflows use v4) and may not exist, risking workflow failures.
planSteps: Fix scripts/verify-ci-runner line 17: add 'bash' to the tool loop so it reads 'for tool in bash tar gzip grep find git gh bun node gcc unzip chromium fc-match jq curl; do' — matching verify-nix-base and the flake.nix runtime_tools metadata.
Fix tests/test_flake_contract.py line 60: update the assertIn for verify-ci-runner to include 'bash' in the expected tool list, matching the corrected script.
Remove 'CODEOWNERS' from the grep pattern in .github/workflows/auto-merge.yml line 39 since no CODEOWNERS file exists in the repository.
Change actions/checkout@v7.0.1 to actions/checkout@v4 in publish-ci-runner.yml line 40 and verify-ci-runner.yml lines 36 and 72, matching the other workflows in this repo.
Run bash -n on all scripts to verify syntax. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v to verify tests pass.
